system.description: This spell creates a magical barrier all around the spellcaster (less than an inch away). It moves with the spellcaster. While the duration lasts, the spellcaster has an AC of 2 against missiles, and AC 4 against all other attacks. If someone shoots a magic missile at a spellcaster protected by this spell, the spellcaster may make a saving throw vs. spells (one saving throw per missile). If the saving throw is successful, the magic missile has no effect; it hits the barrier and evaporates.
